SELECT m.id, m.introduction, m.name, m.image, m.page_views, m.likes, m.comments, m.release_time, m.update_time, m.status FROM meme m WHERE m.status = 1 AND ( m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.introduction LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM meme_tag_relation r INNER JOIN meme_tag t ON r.meme_tag_id = t.id WHERE r.meme_id = m.id AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) ORDER BY
m.likes DESC m.page_views DESC m.comments DESC m.likes DESC
